tagline: 徕卡旁轴相机，1956 年发布
description:
=== Introduction ===

The Leica screw-mount series, also known as the "Barnack" Leicas after their inventor, Oskar Barnack, are a series of 35mm, focal-plane shutter cameras, mostly including coupled rangefinders, made by Ernst Leitz GmbH of Wetzlar, Germany from the mid-1920's until 1960.
